name: Three Dikgosi Monument
subtitle: A bronze sculpture in the Gaborone central business district showing three Batswana chiefs who travelled to Britain in 1895.

facts.label: Who it depicts
facts.value: Khama III, Sebele I and Bathoen I

facts.label: Significance
facts.value: Marks a turning point in Botswana's history (tourism board)

parts.text: A bronze sculpture in the Gaborone central business district showing three Batswana chiefs who travelled to Britain in 1895. It was inaugurated in 2005.
